title: Mutant Bug Lair
wikitext:
[[File:Mutant Bug Lair.png|right|320px]]
The '''Mutant Bug Lair''' is an underground location that becomes accessible as part of the [[Quests#Dark Talisman|Dark Talisman Quest]]. The entrance to the lair is in the northwest corner of [[The Sewers]]. Talking to [[Krobus]] during this quest will open the passage to this location.

The player should be prepared to encounter [[monsters]] before entering the Mutant Bug Lair because there are a number of [[Mutant Grub]]s and [[Mutant Fly|Mutant Flies]] inside.

Even though plants are growing here and [[fishing]] is possible, the game considers this location to be underground.  Therefore, [[Foraging|forageable]] items and [[Artifact Spot|artifact spots]] never spawn here.

==Fishing==
[[File:MutantBugLairDistances.png|thumb|right|300px|[[Fishing#Distance from Land|Distances from land]] in the Mutant Bug Lair]]
The [[Slimejack]] is a unique [[fish]] that can only be caught in the Mutant Bug Lair. [[Carp]], [[Green Algae]], and [[White Algae]] are also possible. The available fish are the same year-round. Fishing here is dangerous because [[Mutant Fly|Mutant Flies]] continuously spawn and attack the player. To avoid this, fish right at the entrance before any bugs are triggered.
